title: Lead In → AI Tier → HubSpot With Retries → Slack → Run Log

sections.label: 1 · RECEIVE AND VALIDATE THE LEAD
sections.note: Every lead is checked before anything downstream runs. A bad payload is rejected with the missing field named, not failed halfway through.

sections.label: 2 · CHECK HUBSPOT FOR AN EXISTING CONTACT
sections.note: One search by email before we create anything. A returning contact is logged and never duplicated in the CRM.

sections.label: 3 · AI QUALIFIES THE LEAD INTO A TIER
sections.note: OpenAI reads the form answers and company details and returns one of Hot, Warm or Cold with a reason. The parser forces the shape so the switch below never gets free text.

sections.label: 4 · ACT BY TIER, RETRY THE CRM IF IT FAILS
sections.note: Hot goes straight into HubSpot as a contact plus a deal. Warm gets a nurture email. Cold is logged only. If HubSpot errors or rate limits, we wait and retry up to three times before giving up.

sections.label: 5 · LOG EVERY RUN, ALERT ON ANY FAILURE
sections.note: Sales sees every qualified lead in Slack. Every run writes a log row with tier, ids and timing. Anything that breaks anywhere pings the channel with a link to the failed execution.

input_sample.message: We manage about 300 rental units and our leasing inquiries are falling through the cracks. Looking for someone to automate follow-up and get everything into HubSpot. Budget approved for Q4.

output_sample.reason: Named a live pain (leasing inquiries lost), a concrete volume (300 units), a decision-maker role, and approved Q4 budget.
